summary: Advance Phase 1A, start alias design, and keep core work narrowly constrained.

changes.reason: A bucket analysis has enough evidence to move from exploration into an explicit join-coverage implementation plan.
The next free focus slot should move into the alias-builder design track rather than opening another core change stream.
The focus cap is now explicit, so core instability remains a risk but is better controlled.

before.mitigation: Limit active tracks to three and route most new work into backlog until current focus clears.

after.mitigation: Keep active work capped at three tracks and reject incidental production edits outside the focus set.
